title: Cibanda Ca Edeni
verses: Nyika imbotu ya Edeni, Kuli kuumuna,
Mu moyo onse ulila, Uyaku komana,
chorus: Nyika imbotu ya Edeni, Munzi usalala,

title: Klistu Na Balabas
verses: Muziindi zya masunko muyume ba Klistu.

title: Leta Kwakumi Koonse
writer: Helen E. Rasmussen / Henry Lake Gilmour
verses: Komvwa majwi azwa mwibbuku lya Mwami,
Kulipa kwako ku Mwami kube kwini
englishVerses: Hear the words of Scripture from the ages past,
“Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse.”
Make a consecration that will ever last,
Trusting for the promised blessing.
Do you seek to know the Holy Spirit’s pow’r? “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse.”
Live in sweet communion with Him hour by hour, While He gives the promised blessing.
Is there aught that stands between you and your Lord? “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse.”
Bring them on conditions promised in His word, And He’ll pour you out a blessing.
Lift your heart this moment, claim Him Lord and King,
As ye bring the tithes into the storehouse;
Trust the blessed promise, and your praise shall ring,
From the heart He is possessing.
Let the anthems roll in grandeur thro’ the skies, Having bro’t the tithes into the storehouse;
Joyous hallelujahs from our hearts arise, For we have the promised blessing.
englishChorus: “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, And prove me now,” saith the Lord of hosts;
“And I will pour you out a blessing,
There shall not be room enough to receive it.”

title: Buzuba Busalala
verses: Buzuba busalala, Bwa mvwiki ya kulenga
Buzuba bwa ciloba, Twa lyokezya anguwe.
Jula Bbuku uzyibe, Baibele lya kaka.
Bazyi kasimpe bati, Muntu wa busandula,
Kuzwa ku malemgelo, nSabata njiya Mwami.
Nenda yiya mwi Bbuku, Ndazyiba I nSabata,
Elyo nda mucilila, Kunyina nzila imbi.
chorus: Bola, bola, bola, bola, Buzuba bwa nSabata,
(Bola, bola, bola, bola, bola, bola, bola, bola)
englishVerses: Holy day, Jehovah’s rest,
Of creation’s week the best;
Last of all the chosen seven,
Blessed of God, to man ‘twas given.
First His six days’ work was done,
Then the Sabbath was begun;
Thus He blessed the seventh day,
Thus in resting we obey.
Thousands have His plan reversed,
Resting now upon the first;
Search the book and you shall know,
There’s no scripture tells them so.
All who speak the truth must say,
It was man who changed the day;
In God’s word no change appears,
Through the whole six thousand years.
Thus I searched; and when I saw,
Only one great Sabbath law,
Then I Hasten to obey,
Plainly, ‘twas  the only way.
englishChorus: Welcome, welcome,
(Welcome, welcome, ever welcome,)
Welcome          welcome;
(welcome, welcome, ever welcome;)
Glad we hail its presence blest,
‘Tis the great Jehovah’s rest.

title: Luumuno Lubotu
writer: Edward H. Bickersteth / George T. Caldbeck
englishVerses: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus: this is rest
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus’ bosom nought but calm is found.
Peace, perfect peace, with loved far away?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
In Jesus’ keeping we are safe, and they.
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

title: Jesu Ndila Kucilila
writer: Grace Glenn (L. M. Beal Bateman) / J. H. Rosecrans
verses: Munzila zyonse zyangu, Amuzibi ndi gusye,
englishVerses: Jesus, I will follow Thee,
For I hear Thee calling me;
Loving, trusting, glad I come,
To let Thee lead me home.
Little eyes might lose the way,
Little feet might go astray;
I might weak and weary be,
But Thou art strong for me.
Grief and want may be my foes;
Foolish sins my way oppose;
Full of courage I will be,
Whene’er I follow Thee.
englishChorus: I will follow Thee, I will follow Thee,
I will follow Thee, Wherever Thou dost lead.

title: Komwaya Micelo Ya Luse
writer: Mary Riley Smith / Silas J. Vail
verses: Ajanza lyakwe ligusya masunko a munzila.
Amwekesya a kusika naa yuma amakumbi a izuba,
Na tozi minwe ya Mwana noyaba azicisa takwe,
Kusobana limbi tajati zi mucisa- sena,
Tulatuyeya O to tunwe notwamba mucamba,
chorus: Tumwaye I micelo, Tumwaye I micelo,
I micelo ya luse kuti tukatebule.
englishVerses: Let us gather up the sunbeams,
Lying all around our path;
Let us keep the wheat and roses,
Casting out the thorns and chaff;
Let us find our sweetest comfort,
In the blessings of the today,
With a patient hand removing,
All the briers from the way.
Strange we never prize the music,
Till the sweet-voiced bird is flown!
Strange that we should slight the violets,
Till the lovely flowers are gone!
Strange that summer skies and sunshine,
Never seem one half so fair,
As when winter’s snowy pinions,
Shake the white down in the air.
If we knew the baby fingers,
Pressed against the window pane,
Would be cold and stiff tomorrow,
Never trouble us again,
Would the bright eyes of our darling,
Catch the frown upon our brow?
Would the prints of rosy fingers,
Vex us then as they do now.
Ah! Those little ice-cold fingers,
How they point our mem’ries back,
To the hasty words and actions,
Strewn along our backward track!
How those little hands remind us,
As in snowy grace they lie,
Not to scatter thorns but roses,
For our reaping by and by.
englishChorus: Then scatter seeds of kindness,
Then scatter seeds of kindness,
Then scatter seeds of kindness,
For our reaping by and by.

title: Mwami Luwo Lwavula
writer: Mary Ann Baker / Horatio R. Palmer
verses: Tugwasye tuta fwi toonse, Buka utuvune
Noluungisya luwo tugwasye, Tatukwe nzila imbi.
Imoyo wangu wa pengesya, Ndivune ndalombesya,
Bubi bwangu undi gusye, Ndi tube mumoyo,
Ndili afwaafwi kufwa Muvuni, Kobola undijate.
Taata mapenzi amana, Moyo ula lyookezya;
Zuba ndalibona Muvuni, Julu lila lindila,
Akuseka ndiya kukwiimbila, Ku nyika ya cisyomyo.
chorus: Luwo a lwizi nditeelele, ko umuna,
Nakuba mvula yavulisya, Ababi abantu konse konse,
englishVerses: Master the tempest is raging!
The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o’er shadowed with blackness;
No shelter or help is nigh;
Carest Thou not that we perish?
How canst Thou lie asleep,
When each moment so madly is threatening,
A grave in the angry deep.
Master with anguish of spirit,
I bow in my grief today;
The depths of sad hearts are troubled;
O, waken and save I pray!
Torrents of sin and of anguish,
Sweep o’er my sinking soul;
And I perish! I perish dear Master;
O hasten, and take control.
Master, the terror is over,
The element sweetly rest;
Earth’s sun is in the calm lake is mirrored,
And heaven’s within my breast;
Linger O blessed Redeemer,
Leave me alone no more;
And with joy I shall make the blest harbor,
And rest on the blissful shore.
englishChorus: “The winds and the waves shall obey My will,
Peace be still!
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea,
Or demons, or men, or whatever it be,
No water can swallow the ship where lies,
The Master of ocean and earth and skies;
They all shall sweetly obey my will,
Peace, be still! Peace be still!
They all shall sweetly obey My will,
Peace, peace be still!”

title: Mufutuli Ukankamanisya
verses: Mufutuli wangu nguJesu Mwami, Mufutuli waluyando,
Usisa buumi bwangu muli nguwe, Ukuli kukomanisya.
Usisa buumi bwangu muli nguwe, Muli ku komana lyonse,
Ulandisisa mu luyando lwakwe, Undivumba Ôjanza lyakwe,
Mufutuli wangu ngu Jesu Mwami, Utola mukuli wangu,
Nsikazwi muli nguwe undiyumya, Ulandipa nguzu lyonse.
Ulandi leleka mazuba onse, Akundizuzya bulemu,
Mububi bwangu ndamulumba Leza, Kunditumina Muvuni.
Ndamana mulimo ndilakutolwa, Ku muswana mumakumbi,
Lufutuko lupati a luyando, Ndiya kuimba kujulu.

title: Muvuni Wesu
verses: Ijwi lyakwe lya lubomba litwita kwakwe,
Litondezya nzila yakwe ya ku julu.
englishVerses: Our blest Redeemer, ere He breathed His tender, last farewell,
A Guide, a Comforter, bequeathed With us to dwell.
He came sweet influence to impart, A gracious, willing Guest,
While He can find one humble heart Wherein to rest.
And His that gentle voice we hear, Soft as the breath of even,
That checks each fault, that calms each fear, And speaks of heaven.
And every virtue we possess, And every conquest won,
And every thought of holiness, Are His alone.
Spirit of purity and grace, Our weakness, pitying, see:
O make our hearts Thy dwelling place, And worthier Thee.

title: Zibi Zyako Nozi Subila
writer: Fanny J. Crosby / William H. Doane
englishTune: Though Your Sins Be As Scarlet
verses: Zibi zyako nozivula, Ziya ku tubizigwa,
Zibi zyako nozivula, Zya ku tubizigwa.
Mbuli bulowa zisalale, Zila tuba bu,
Zibi zyako nozivula, Zibi zyako nozivula,
Ziya ku tubizigwa, Ziya ku tubizigwa.
Komvwa Mwami ulaita, Kopiluka kwa Leza,
Komvwa Mwami ula ita, Kopiluka kwa Leza,
Komvwa Mwami ulaita, Komvwa Mwami ula ita,
Kopiluka kwa Leza, Kopilika kwa Leza.
Ula lekelela zibi, Aku ziluba lyonse,
Ula lekelela zibi, aku ziluba lyonse,
Ula baita bantu bonse, UlaÕmba Leza,
Ula lekelela zibi, Ula lekelela zibi,
Aku ziluba lyonse, aku ziluba lyonse.
englishVerses: “Though your sins be as scarlet, They shall be as white as snow;
Though your sins be as scarlet, They shall be as white as snow;
Though they be red like crimson,
They shall be as wool!”
“Though your sins be as scarlet, Though your sins be as scarlet,
They shall be as white as snow,
They shall be as white as snow.”
Hear the voice that entreats you, O return ye unto God!
Hear the voice that entreats you, O return ye unto God!
He is of great compassion, And of wondrous love;
Hear the voice that entreats you, Hear the voice that entreats you,
O return ye unto God! O return ye unto God!
He’ll forgive your transgressions,
And remember them no more;
He’ll forgive your transgressions,
And remember them no more;
“Look unto Me, ye people,” Saith the Lord your God!
He’ll forgive your transgressions, He’ll forgive your transgressions,
And remember them no more, And remember them no more.

title: Kowala Intambo Iya Buumi
writer: Edward S. Ufford / George C. Stebbins
englishVerses: Throw out the life-line across the dark wave;
There is a brother whom someone should save;
Somebody’s brother! Oh, who then will dare
To throw out the life-line, his peril to share?
Throw out the life-line with hand quick and strong:
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking; oh, hasten today And out with the life-boat! Away, then, away!
Throw out the life-line to danger-fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you’ve never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.
Soon will the season of rescue be o’er,
Soon will they drift to eternity’s shore;
Haste, then, my brother, no time for delay,
But throw out the life-line and save them today.
englishChorus: Throw out the life-line! Throw out the life-line!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the life-line! Throw out the life-line!
Someone is sinking today.

title: Yama Kumaboko Akwe
verses: Kojata kumaboko a Jesu, Ulakuyumya ulakuyumya;
Naa wa syoma mu luyando lwakwe, Uyakukuyumya.
Ko jata ku maboko a Jesu, U ya kutubya bu nzila yako,
Kojata ku maboko a Jesu, Utamuleki utamusowi,
Mukuli wako oyu mulemu, Mupe Mufutuli.
Kojata ku maboko a Jesu, Mulekele zyonse umu syome
Ulaa luse Mwami mubotu, Ula bona konse.
chorus: Jatilisya syoma jwi lwakwe, Jatilisya mu luse
Lwakwe, Jatilisya langa kujulu, Jatilisya ku Mwami.
englishVerses: Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, He’ll help you along, help you along;
If you will trust His love unfailing, He’ll fill your heart with song.
Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, He’ll brighten the way, brighten the way;
Just follow gladly where He leadeth, His gentle voice obey.
Just lean upon the arms of Jesus, Then leave all to Him, leave all to Him;
His heart is full of love and mercy, His eyes are never dim.
englishChorus: Lean on His arms, trusting in His love; Lean on His arms, all His mercies prove;
Lean on His arms, looking home above, Just lean on the Savior’s arms!

title: Ndijisi Mufutuli
verses: Kuti muyandi wangu ngu Mwami wako,
Baka futuke mu zina lya Jesu.
chorus: Tuka kale tonse ku nyika eyo.
englishVerses: I have a Saviour, he’s pleading in glory,
A dear, loving Saviour, tho’ earth-friends be few;
And now he is watching in tenderness o’er me,
And O that my Saviour were your Saviour too.
I have a Father ; to me He has given,
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon He will call me to meet Him in heaven,
But oh that He’d let me bring with me, too.
I have a robe; ‘tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it, all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one, too.
To me has been given a peace like a river;
A peace that the friends of this world never knew;
And Christ is the Author, and Christ is the Giver,
And O that his peace might be given to you.
When Jesus has found you, tell others the story,
That my loving Saviour is your Saviour too;
Then that your Saviour will bring them to glory,
And prayer will be answered, ‘twas answered for you
englishChorus: For you, I am praying , For you I am praying,
For you I am praying, I’m praying for you.

title: Moongole Nkuli?
writer: John R. Bryant / John R. Sweney
verses: Ibubotu bwa nyika A bwa kujulu?
englishVerses: “Eternity! Where?” It floats in the air;
Amid calm or or silence it ever is there!
The question s solemn, “Eternity! Where?”
The question so solemn, “Eternity! Where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Eternity! Where?
With redeemed ones in glory, or lost in despair?
‘Tis one or the other, “Eternity! Where?”
‘Tis one or the other, “Eternity! Where?”
Eternity! Where?” Oh! How can you share,
The world’s giddy pleasures, or heedlessly dare.
Do aught till you settle, “Eternity! Where?”
Do aught till you settle, “Eternity! Where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Friend, have a care;
Soon God will no longer His judgment forebear;
This day may decide your “Eternity! Where?”
This day may decide your “Eternity where?”
“Eternity! Where?” Oh! Eternity! Where?
Friend, sleep not, nor take in the world any share,
Till you answer this question, “Eternity! Where?”
Till you answer this question, “Eternity! Where?”

title: Wandiyandaula
verses: Jesu Muvuni mu Betelehemu, Wakazyalilwa muciba kuya;
Alilumbwe izina lya Mwami, Wakafwida ime,
Alilumbwe izina lya Mwami, Wakafwida ime.
Jesu Muvuni a Kalivali, Wakabbadela kuula ndime;
Kuti ndi anguluke mucibi, Wakafwida ime
Jesu Muvuni webo wakale, Wakandiyanda azibi zyangu;
Akundi tola mu munzi wako, Ulaita ime,
Ula ita ime, Ula ita ime,
Akundi tola mu munzi wako, Ula ita ime.
Jesu Muvuni uya kubola, Mucisyomyo cakwe ulaboola;
Ndiya kumubona kaseluka, Ku bolela ime,
englishVerses: Jesus, my Saviour to Bethlehem came,
Born in a manger to sorrow and shame;
O, it was wonderful, blest be His name!
Seeking for me, for me.
Seeking for me, for me, seeking for me, for me,
O, it was wonderful, blest be His name!
Seeking for me, for me.
Jesus, my Saviour, on Calvary’s tree,
Paid the great debt and my soul He set free;
O, it was wonderful, how could it be?
Dying for me, for me.
Dying for me, for me, dying for me, for me,
O, it was wonderful, how could it be?
Dying for me, for me.
Jesus, my Saviour, the same as of old,
While I was wand’ring afar from the fold,
Gently and long did He plead with my soul,
Calling for me, for me,
Calling for me, for me, calling for me, for me,
Gently and long did He plead with my soul,
Calling for me, for me.
Jesus my Saviour shall come from on high,
Sweet is the promise as weary years fly,
O, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me.
Coming for me, for me, coming for me, for me,
O, I shall see Him descending the sky,
Coming for me, for me.

title: Mumuni Ndisololele
writer: John Henry Newman / John B. Dykes
verses: Ndakali kuenda munzila zibi nkita kuzyi;
Ndaka cita zintu zibi, kuli ndiwe,
Na ndalelekwa mu nguzu zya Mwami; Ndilaunka,
englishVerses: Lead, kindly Light, amid the encircling gloom,
Lead Thou me on;
The night is dark, and I am far from home;
Lead Thou me on.
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see,
The distant scene; one step’s enough for me.
I was not ever thus, nor prayed that
Thou Shouldst lead me on;
I loved to choose and see my path; but now,
Lead Thou me on.
I loved the garish day, and, spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will, Remember not passed years.
So long Thy power hath blest me, sure it still,
Will lead me on;
O’er moor and fen, o’er crag and torrent, till,
The night is gone;
And with the morn those angel faces smile,
Which I have loved long since, and lost awhile.

title: Kutali Nzila Ya Ngu
verses: Nzila nji yako Mwami, Nakuba yasiya mbi
Ndisalile O Leza, Ndiende munzila yako.
Bulelo bwako ndalomba, Mbubwako a nzila yoonse,
Iyo itola ku munzi, Ndita soweki limbi,
englishVerses: Thy way, not mine, O lord, However dark it be;
Lead me by thine own hand, And chose the path for me.
I dare not choose my lot; I would not if I might;
Choose thou for me, my God, So shall I walk a-right.
The kingdom that I seek, Is thine; so let the way,
That leads to it be thine, Else I must surely stray,
Hold thou my cup of life; With joy or sorrow fill,
As best to thee may seem; Choose thou my good and ill
Choose thou for me my friends, My sickness or my health;
Choose thou my cares for me, My poverty or wealth,
Not mine, not mine the choice, In either great or small,
Be thou my Guide, my Strength, My Wisdom, and my All.

title: Boola Kuli Ndiwe
verses: Moyo wangu wausa, Meso ata boni;
chorus: Bweza joko lyangu, Cilila nzila zyangu,
Ndime Mufutuli wenu, Mukalyookezye muli ndime.
englishVerses: O heart bowed down with sorrow! O eyes that long for sight!
There’s gladness in believing; In Jesus there is light.
Earth’s fleeting gain and pleasure Can never satisfy;
’Tis love our joy doth measure, For love can never die.
Divinest consolation Doth Christ the Healer give;
Art thou in condemnation? Repent, believe, and live.
His peace is like a river, His love is like a song;
His yoke’s a burden never, ’Tis easy all the way.
englishChorus: “Come unto Me, all ye that labor,
And are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Take My yoke upon you, and learn of Me, for My yoke is easy.”

title: Mwami Wesu
verses: Twa imba sunu inyimbo yesu imbotu,
Na ka li munyika wa li ku yanda bana,
U li kujulu pesi u la tu yandisya.
Tu la yanda ku telela kambo ka Jesu,
Milimo yakwe yonse wa kali munyika.
Jesu wesu twa vuntama kumbele kwako,
Twa lomba Jesu utu gwasye ku ku yanda.
chorus: Tu la imba nkubotu kwa Mwami,
englishVerses: Our sweetest songs of gladness, On this delightful day,
We bring to praise the Saviour, Who is the Life, the Way.
He loved the little children, When he was here below;
And thou he’s up in heaven, He loves us yet we know.
We love to sing his praises, And hear the stories told,
Of Him when he was dwelling, In Galilee of old.
He loved the little children, When he was here below;
And thou he’s up in heaven, He loves us yet we know.
O Savour, blessed Saviour, We kneel before thy throne,
And ask that thou wilt help us, To live for thee alone.
englishChorus: We sing...we sing, The praises of our King,
(We sing)... (We sing) (Heav’nly King)
We sing... we sing  The glory of our King.
(We sing)...(We sing)

title: Inyenyezi Imbotu
verses: Nyenyezi mbotu munguzu zyakwe, Ya kasololelwa,
Akutubya bantu basongo yakabatola nkwa kazyalilwa I Mufutuli.
I ya kumweka bakacilila ya kabatola,
Atucilile mumuni uyo, Mbuli bakale tuyakuzunda,
Atucilile ijwi lya Mwami Limwi tukasike ku julu.
chorus: I la munika ilasalazya nyenyezi iyo,
Ya Lufutuko I lamunika I lasalazya,
englishVerses: A beautiful star arose one night,
Divinely it shone with purest light;
Its wonderful rays the wise men led,
To find the Saviour’s lowly bed.
They knew by the word of truth divine,
‘Twas time that the guiding star should shine;
They followed its light which shone afar,
‘Twas Christ, “the bright and morning star.”
We’ll follow its light, like those of old,
The “Light of the World,” by seers foretold;
We’ll follow his light till we shall come,
To perfect rest in heaven, my home.
englishChorus: ‘Tis shining still, ‘tis shining still,
That beautiful star, o’er plain and hill;
‘Tis shining still, ‘tis shining still,
Salvation’s star of God’s good will.

title: Zyuulu Kumi Zya Tulumbu
verses: Komvwa zilimba a majwi, Zilumbaizya Mwami,
Kujulu kuli kuseka, Jesu Mwami wa luse langa ukede
Mwami wesu wabulemu, Kukabe kutamani basalidwe,
Bonse bakwe baya kukomanisya, Kukomana anguwe,
Mwami kofwamba kusika, Leta buzuba bwako ibubotu,
Twatelela julÕanyika zyamana Atulumbu tuya kwimba,
Bulemu ku Mwami wesu, Aleluya, Aleluya, Aleluya.
englishVerses: Hark! Ten thousand harps and voices,
Sound the note of praise above;
Jesus reigns, and heav’n rejoices,
Jesus reigns, the God of love;
See, he its on yonder throne;
Jesus rules the world alone,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.
King of glory, reign forever,
Thine an everlasting crown;
Nothing from thy love shall ever,
Those whom dost seal thine own;
Happy objects of thy grace,
Destined to behold thy face,
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.
Saviour, hasten thine appearing;
Bring, O bring, the glorious day;
When the awful summons hearing,
Heav’n and earth shall pass away!
Then with golden harps, we’ll sing,
“Glory, glory to our King.”
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Amen.

title: Hena Ndiwe? Hena Nidme?
verses: Umwi aka njile mu munzi, Lino lino lino lino;
Kumvwa bulemu bulindila, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
UmwÕuyakwenda mumigwagwa, Bubotu bwa nkuko abone,
Bubotu bwa nkuko bumvwidwe, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi aka tule Ciingano, Lino lino, lino lino;
Musyini uya kuba Ônguwe, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi uya kubona Mwami, Mapenzi a nyika amana,
Kukomana anguwe lyoonse, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi uya kukonkomona, Lino lino, lino lino;
Ijwi lyamba kuti nsekuzyi, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi takapengwi bulumbu, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi uya kwimba kukoma, Lino lino, lino lino;
Kulumbaizya abasale, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
Umwi uya kwanzya kunkomwe, Bayandwa Ônyika bakaswane.
Mubulemu kukabe lyonse, Hena ndiwe? Hena ndime?
englishVerses: Some one will enter the pearly gate;
By and by, by and by,
Taste of the glories that there await,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some-one will the streets of gold,
Beautiful visions will there behold,
Feast on the pleasures so long foretold
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will gladly his cross lay down;
By and by, by and by,
Faithful, approved, shall receive a crown,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one the glorious King will see,
Ever from sorrow of earth be free,
Happy with Him through eternity;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will knock when the door is shut,
By and by, by and by,
Hear a voice saying, “I know you not;”
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will call and shall not be heard,
Vainly will strive when the door is barred,
Some one will fail of the saints’ reward;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will sing the triumphant song,
By and by, by and by,
Join in the praise with the blood-bought throng,
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?
Some one will greet on the golden shore,
Loved ones of earth, pain and parting o’er,
Safe in the glory forevermore;
Shall you? Shall I? Shall you? Shall I?

title: Mazuba Na Amana
englishTune: While The Days Are Going By
verses: Nkobali ba yanda ijwi, Mazuba naamana,
englishVerses: There are lonely hearts to cherish,
While the days are going by;
There are weary souls who perish,
While the days are going by;
If a smile we can renew,
As our journey we pursue,
O, the good we all may do,
While the days are going by.
There is no time for idle scorning,
While the days are going by;
Let your face be like the morning,
While the days are going by;
For the world is full of sighs,
Full of sad and weeping eyes;
Help your fallen brother rise,
While the days are going by.
All the loving links that bind us,
While the days are going by;
One by one we leave behind us,
While the days are going by,
But the seeds of good we sow,
Both in shade and shine will grow,
And will keep our hearts aglow,
While the days are going by.
englishChorus: Going by,       going by,       Going by,      going by,
(Going by)       (going by)        (going by)     (going by)
O, the good we all may do,
While the days are going by!

title: Kuli Munzi Wa Luumuno
englishTune: There Is A Place Of Quiet Rest
verses: Kuli munzi wa lumuno, Ku cuno ca Leza,
U ko cibi tacijanwi kucuno ca Leza.
Cilawo ca kulyokezya ku cuno ca Leza,
Nkotuya kuswana a Mwami, Ku cuno ca Leza.
Ku munzi wa lwanguluko, ku cuno ca Leza,
Oko kuli kukomana, ku cuno ca Leza.
chorus: O Jesu Mufutuli, O zwa kuli Leza,
englishVerses: There is a place of quiet rest,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where sin can not molest,
Near to the heart of God.
There is a place of comfort sweet,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where we our Saviour meet,
Near to the heart of God.
There is a place of full release,
Near to the heart of God;
A place where all is joy and peace,
Near to the heart of God.
englishChorus: O Jesus, blest Redeemer,
Sent from the heart of God,
Hold us, who wait before Thee,
Near to the heart of God.

title: Ko Ndi Tola
verses: No tu ya ku unka ku Zioni,
Kwe nkamu impati, Ndi la kwimba,
Abo, Lwimbo lwa ku nununwa, ko.
Ndi la ku ba bona ba Isreali,
chorus: Ko ndi tola, Ndi tole ku Zioni,
Ndi tole ku munzi wa luyando,
englishVerses: O how I long to see that day,
When the redeemed shall come
To Zion, clad in white array,
Their blissful, happy home.
I’ll hear the alleluias roll,
From the unnumbered throng,
And with a heaven-enraptured soul,
I’ll join redemption’s song.
All hail! The morn of glory’s nigh,
The pilgrim longs to see;
That dries the tear from every eye,
Creation’s jubilee.
englishChorus: O bear me on, bear me on, To Mount Zion,
O bear me on to that city of love,
Where saints shall ever dwell.

title: Muciindi Camasunko
verses: Muluse ndiimike Taata ndi Mwana wako,

title: Bakaleta Zipengo Zyabo Kuli Jesu
englishTune: They Brought Their Gifts To Jesus
verses: Ba ka leta zipego zyabo kuli Jesu,
Jesu wa tambula luyando lwabo lonse,
Milimo mibotu a ku gwasya bacete,
Jesu  wa zi yanda zipego zyabo zyonse.
Ambali kwa bapi kwa ka imvwi mucete,
Wa bona zipego zyabo zyonse zibotu,
Elyo wa ku yanda ku tola cipego,
Pesi kunyina nca jisi ku mu tolela.
Wa lila ÒMwami ndi ku zyi u li syiluse,
Ko tolankwe ndi jisi, moyo wangu mubi,Ó
Jesu wa mwambila uta ciiti ncisyonto
Zyonse nzibotu pesi cako ci la inda.
chorus: Sena u yanda ku mu letela nca yanda,
Ko mwambila, Mwami nda ku pa moyo wangu.
englishVerses: They brought their gifts to Jesus,
And laid them at His feet,
And love for this dear Saviour,
Made every offering sweet;
Good deeds and words of kindness,
Help for the poor of earth,
And not a gift among them,
Was thought of little worth.
Apart from other givers,
A poor way-farer stood;
He saw the gifts they offered,
The poorest counted good,
And he was filled with longing,
A gift, though poor to bring;
Alas! All empty- handed,
He stood before the King.
“Dear Lord,” he cried in sorrow,
“I know kind Thou art,
Take all I have to give Thee,
My sinful way-ward heart;”
Then Jesus answered softly,
”Count not the gift as small,
Though all of them are precious,
Thine is the best of all.”
englishChorus: Wouldst bring a gift to Jesus,
That He will count most sweet?
Say “Lord, my heart I give Thee,”
And lay it at His feet.

title: Nditole Mbwendi
writer: Eliza H. Hamilton / John H. Stockton
verses: Jesu O Mwami ndakwita, Ndigwasye nendi mulufu,
Ndalomba ku cuno cako, Ndibone ndakulombesya,
Nditume oko nkoyanda, Ndisandule ndi salazye
Mulimo wako wamana, Nkondo ya lwanwa ndakoma,
Ndiya kukwita O Mwami, Nditole mbwebede.
englishVerses: Jesus, my Lord, to thee I cry;
Unless thou help me I must die;
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.
Helpless I am, and full of guilt,
But yet thy blood for me was spilt;
And thou canst make what thou wilt,
But take me as I am.
No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break;
Yet save me for thine own name’s sake,
And take me as I am.
I bow before thy mercy seat,
Behold me, Saviour, at thy feet;
Thy work begin, thy work complete,
And take me as I am.
If thou hast work for me to do,
Inspire my will, my heart renew;
And work both in, and by me, too,
And take me as I am.
And when at last the work is done,
The battle fought, the vict’ry won;
Still, still my cry shall be alone,
Lord, take me as I am.
englishChorus: Take me as I am, Take me as I am,
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.

title: Nyonena Jesu
verses: Twa komana ku nyonena Jesu, Manza esu a la zumina,
Konse nkwa twambila tu ku cite, Mu ku syomeka tu la nyona.
A ku seka tuka ambe kambo, Ka luyando lwakwe ku bantu,
Jesu kasalala kwakwe usyi, U la tu abila bulelo.
A ku li senda, tu mu cilile Mu kukondwa munzila yakwe,
Tu sololele benzu kwa Jesu, Tu tondezye babisyi Jesu.
chorus: Nyonena Jesu, Muku komana, muku komana,
Nyonena Jesu, Mu munda wakwe muno.
englishVerses: Gladly, gladly, toiling for the Master,
Go we forth with willing hands to do;
Whatso’er to us he hath appointed,
Faithfully our mission we’ll pursue.
Joyful, joyful, we will tell the story,
Of his love to mortals here below;
Christ, the brightness of the Father’s glory,
Freely here his blessing will bestow.
Meekly, meekly, following the Master,
Walking faithfully the path he trod;
Leading wand’rers to the dear Redeemer,
Pointing sinners to the Lamb of God.
englishChorus: Toil…………ing for Jesus,
(Toiling, toiling for the Master) (yes)
Joyfully we go,      joyfully we go;
Toil…………ing for Jesus,
(Toiling, toiling for the Master)
In his vineyard here below.

title: Weelede Mwana Mbelele
verses: Bona mwana mbelele, Oyu Mwana mbelele;
englishVerses: Worthy, worthy, is the Lamb,
Worthy, worthy, is the Lamb;
Worthy, worthy, is the Lamb,That was slain.
Saviour, let Thy kingdom come!
Now  the power of sin consume;
Bring Thy blest millennium,
Holy Lamb.
Thus may we each moment feel,
Love Him, serve Him, praise Him still;
Till we all on Zion’s hill, See the Lamb.
englishChorus: Glory, hallelujah! Praise Him, hallelujah!
Glory, hallelujah! To the Lamb!

title: Twanzi Tobile
verses: NdÕa twanza tobile, mulaka, twakumusebenzela Jesu,
Tutwi tobile twakumvwa zyamba, Kajwi kaku mwimbila.
NdÕa tutende tobile twakuenda munzila Ôya kujulu,
Twiso tobile twiya mwi Bbuku aluyando lwa Jesu
NdÕa moyo omwe kupa Jesu a mubili kundifutula
Andisebenzye mubumi Kuti ndikale ndili wakwe
englishVerses: I’ve two little hands to work for Jesus
One little tongue his praise to tell,
Two little ears to hear his counsel,
One little voice a song to swell.
I’ve two little feet to tread the pathway,
Up to the heavenly courts above;
Two little eyes to read the Bible,
Telling of Jesus’ wondrous love.
I’ve one little heart to give to Jesus,
One little soul for him to save;
One little life for His dear service,
One little self that he must have.
englishChorus: Lord, we come, Lord, we come,
In our childhood’s early morning,
Lord, we come, Lord, we come,
Come to learn of thee.

title: Nko Nko
writer: Harriet Beecher Stowe / George F. Root
verses: Nkonko, nkonko, Nguni uyo? Linda, linda
O kwabota, Ngu silweendo mweenzu wa bwami
Nkonko, nkonko, Ncinzi ico, Linda linda,
Lwa Muvuni ulindila, Jula moyo anjile.
chorus: Lelo cibi naciko-sa Nseku shakosha ici-bi
englishVerses: Knocking, knocking, who is there?
Waiting, waiting, O how fair!
‘Tis a Pilgrim, strange and kindly,
Never such was seen before;
Ah! My soul, for such a wonder,
Wilt thou not undo the door?
Wilt thou undo the door?
Knocking, knocking, still He’s there,
Waiting, waiting, wondrous fair;
But the door is hard to open,
For the weeds and ivy vine,
With their dark and clinging tendrils,
Ever round the hinges twine,
Ever round the hinges twine.
Knocking, knocking, what! Still there?
Waiting, waiting, grand and fair;
Yes, the wounded hand still knocketh,
And beneath the thorn-wreath’d hair,
Beam the patient eyes, so tender,
Of thy Saviour waiting there;
Wilt thou keep him waiting there?

title: Jala A Buumi Bwakwe
verses: Kolanga Jesu takwe cibi, Tata ndizuzye bumi bwakwe,
Ndili mubisyi ndisandule, Kondisalazya ndi tube bu.
Bubisyi bwangu bwavulisya ndilayowa ku Ôlanga kwako,
Kobola Jesu unditole, Ndizwe muzibi zya munyika.
Bubotu bwakwe ndilayanda kusalala kwako O Jesu,
Mwami ndalomba konditubya, Ndisame musyini wa buumi.
Wakandi fwida akundivuna, Ndili mubisyi wanditubya,
Ndiyiye majwi ako Mwami, Nditembaule Zina lyako.
chorus: Kondisalazya nditube bu, Koba a andime ndikuzyibe,
Ndili mubisyi ndisandule, Kondisalazya nditube bu.
englishVerses: Look upon Jesus, sinless is He;
Father, impute His life unto me,
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.
Deep are the wounds transgression has made;
Red are the stains, my soul is afraid,
O to be covered, Jesus, with Thee,
Safe from the law that now judgeth me!
Longing the joy of pardon to know,
Jesus holds out a robe white as snow;
“Lord, I accept it! Leaving my own,
Gladly I wear Thy pure life alone.”
Reconciled by His death for my sin,
Justified by His life pure and clean,
Sanctified by obeying His word,
Glorified when returneth my soul.
englishChorus: Cover with His life, whiter than snow,
Fullness of His life then shall I know;
My life of scarlet, my sin and woe,
Cover with His life, whiter than snow.

title: Kolizya Mukunga Wa Nkondo
verses: Atu libambe kulwana mubi, Tu lwanine Mufutuli;
Bweza zilwanyo tuime tonse, Muyume mujwi lyakwe Mwami.
Tuyume tonse kulwana mubi, Tumu tondezya kasimpe,
Intobo yesu nku kusalala, Mu kasimpe tuya kukoma.
Mwami wa bonse kotu telela, No tukuita Siluse,
Nkondo yamana tonse twa zunda, Tupe musyini utamani.
englishVerses: Sound the battle cry, See! The foe is nigh;
Raise the standard high for the Lord;
Gird your armor on, Stand firm every one,Rest your cause upon His holy word.
Strong to meet the foe, Marching on we go,
While our cause we know  must prevail;
Shield and banner bright, Gleaming in the light,
Battling for the right, we ne’er can fail.
O Thou God of all Hear us while we call,
Help us one and all, by Thy grace;
When the battle’s done, And the victory won,
May we wear the crown before Thy face.
englishChorus: Rouse, then, soldiers! Rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

title: Kondi Sololela Mufutuli: Lead Me, Saviour
verses: Ndi kale munsi kwako, Nkaambo nsijisi nguzu
Ndikale munsi kwako, Nkaambo ndiwe Muvuni,
Mwami nditole kwako, Ndilube zya munyika,
englishVerses: Saviour, lead me lest I stray,
Gently lead me all the way;
I am safe when by thy side,
I would in thy love abide.
Thou the refuge of my soul,
When life’s stormy billows roll;
I am safe when thou art nigh,
All my hopes on thee rely.
Saviour, lead me till at last,
When the storm of life is past;
I shall reach the land of day,
Where all tears are wiped away.
englishChorus: Lead me, lead me, Saviour, lead me, lest I stray;
Gently down the stream of time,
Lead me Saviour, all the way.

title: Kwakali Uzumina
writer: Carrie E. Breck / Grant Colfax Tullar
englishTune: There Was One Who Was Willing
englishVerses: There was One who was willing to die in my stead,
That a soul so unworthy might live;
And the path to the cross He was willing to tread,
All the sins of my life to forgive.
He is tender and loving and patient with me, While He cleanses my heart of its dross;
But “there’s no condemnation”—I know I am free, For my sins are all nailed to the cross.
I will cling to my Savior and never depart—I will joyfully journey each day,
With a song on my lips and a song in my heart, That my sins have been taken away.
englishChorus: They are nailed to the cross, they are nailed to the cross,
O how much He was willing to bear!
With what anguish and loss, Jesus went to the cross!
But He carried my sins with Him there.

title: Taaku Ca Ngu Zyoonse Nsizyako
englishTune: None Of Self And All Of Thee
verses: Nzizyangu taku cako, Nzizyangu taku cako,
Kaambo kangu Mufutuli acisamu waka yaswa,
Kuli kwangu a kwako, Kuli kwangu a kwako,
Moyo wangu wazumina, ÒKuli kwangu a kwako.Ó
Luse lwakwe lusilika, Lugwasya bantu boonse,
Kunji tola nku kwako, Kunji tola nku kwako,
Kwandipa kuti nzumine, ÒKunji tola nku kwako.Ó
Luyando lwako luteeli, Luinda zintu zyoonse,
Ndazumina lino Mwami, ÒKoonse tola nku kwako,Ó
Koonse tola nku kwako, Koonse tola nku kwako,
Ndazumina lino Mwami, ÒKoonse tola nku kwako.Ó
englishVerses: O the bitter shame and sorrow, That a time could ever be,
When I let the Savior’s pity Plead in vain, and proudly answered: “All of self, and none of Thee!”
All of self, and none of Thee, All of self, and none of Thee,
When I proudly said to Jesus: “All of self, and none of Thee!”
Yet He found me; I beheld Him Bleeding on the accursèd tree,
Heard Him pray, “Forgive them, Father!” And my wistful heart said faintly: “Some of self, and some of Thee!”
Some of self, and some of Thee, Some of self, and some of Thee,
And my wistful heart said faintly: “Some of self, and some of Thee!”
Day by day His tender mercy, Healing, helping, full and free,
Sweet and strong, and, ah! so patient, Brought me lower, while I whispered: “Less of self, and more of Thee!”
Less of self, and more of Thee, Less of self, and more of Thee,
Brought me lower, while I whispered: “Less of self, and more of Thee!”
Higher than the highest heaven, Deeper than the deepest sea,
Lord, Thy love at last hath conquered; Grant me now my supplication—None of self, and all of Thee!
None of self, and all of Thee, None of self, and all of Thee,
Lord, Thy love at last hath conquered: None of self, and all of Thee!

title: Lyoonse Ku Komana
verses: Myoyo yesu ikomane, Tutabi a kuyowa;
Taata wesu wa luyando, Watu tambula kwakwe.
Watu syomya luse lwakwe, Cisyomyo citamani.
Atuyiye ijwi lyakwe, Tusiye zibi zyonse.
englishVerses: Let our hearts be always cheerful;
Why should murmuring enter there,
When our kind and loving Father,
Makes us children of His care.
With His gentle hand to lead us,
Should the pow’rs of sin assail,
He has promised grace to help us;
Never can His promise fail.
When we turn aside from duty,
Comes the pain of doing wrong;
And a shadow, creeping o’er us,
Checks the rapture of our song.
Oh! The good are always happy,
And their path is ever bright;
Let us heed the blessed counsel,
Shun the wrong and love the right.
englishChorus: Always cheerful, always cheerful,
Sunshine all around we see;
Full of beauty is the path of duty,
Cheerful we may always be.

title: Kulyookezya Kwabapengede
writer: Samuel Y. Harmer / John W. Dadmun
verses: Munzi walo wa mu Klistu nkokuli kulyookezya
Oko ndiya kukomana ku munzi usalala.
Lufu talukabi omo bukali buya kuzwa,
Milyango iya ku julwa mu njile mu Zioni.
chorus: Kuli I kulyookezya kuli i Kulyookezya,
Kuli I kulyookezya kwa moyo wako.
englishVerses: In the Christian’s home in glory,
There remains a land of rest
And my Saviour’s gone before me,
To fulfill my soul’s request.
He is fitting up my mansion,
Which eternally shall stand,
For my stay shall be transient,
In that holy, happy land.
Pain or sickness ne’er shall enter,
Grief nor woe my lot shall share;
But in that celestial center,
I a crown of life shall wear.
Death itself shall then be vanquished,
And its stung shall be withdrawn;
Shout for gladness, O ye ransomed!
Hail with joy the rising morn.
Sing, O sing, ye heirs of glory,
Shout your triumph as you go;
Zion’s gates will open for you,
You shall find an entrance through.
englishChorus: There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for the weary,
There is rest for you.
On the other side of Jordan,
In the sweet fields of Eden,
Where the tree of life is blooming,
There is rest for you.

title: Munyina Sumina
verses: Kufwamba tunjile munzi umweka, Kwiimba lwiimbo lwakuzunda
Mukwesu syomeka ku mufutuli Nkaambo nzi ncotasyomeki
Munzi wa golide ulibambidwe Kuli baabo basyomeka,
Musinze wakuusa lino wamana tunjile mukusalala.
Mukwesu syomeka Jesu ulaboola, Mwami Mulengi Singuzu
Mukwesu syomeka lino ulamvwa, Ijwi lya Mwami lilaamba,
Mulanda usyomeka watambulwa Mukukkomana kwa Mwami
Myaka mibotu yakupona lyoonse, lyotondezya  kusyomeka
Kukkomana a musyini umweka kuyogusya imisozi
Mukwesu cisyomyo cili masimpe, Cilindilila bakasunkwa
Kulela antoomwe aba kazunda, A Jesu kutakamani.
englishVerses: O brother, be faithful! soon Jesus will come,
For whom we have waited so long;
O, soon we shall enter our glorious home,
And join in the conqueror’s song.
O brother, be faithful! for why should we prove Unfaithful to Him who hath shown
Such deep, such unbounded and infinite love—
Who died to redeem us His own.
O brother, be faithful! the city of gold,
Prepared for the good and the blest,
Is waiting its portals of pearl to unfold,
And welcome thee into thy rest.
Then, brother, prove faithful! not long shall we stay
In weariness here, and forlorn,
Time’s dark night of sorrow is wearing away,
We haste to the glorious morn.
O brother, be faithful! He soon will descend,
Creation’s omnipotent King,
While legions of angels His chariot attend,
And palm-wreaths of victory bring.
O brother, be faithful! and soon shalt thou hear
Thy Savior pronounce the glad word,
“Well done, faithful servant; thy title is clear
To enter the joy of thy Lord.”
O brother, be faithful! eternity’s years
Shall tell for thy faithfulness now,
When bright smiles of gladness shall scatter thy tears,
And a coronet gleam on thy brow.
O brother, be faithful! the promise is sure,
That waits for the faithful and tried;
To reign with the ransomed, immortal and pure,
And ever with Jesus abide.

title: Nditambule Mwebede
writer: Eliza H. Hamilton / John H. Stockton
verses: Kokala ambebo lyoose, Nsiyandi kukalÕ endike;
Undi futule O Mwami, Ndifutule ime.
Ime ndi muntu mubisyi, Pesi Ôwe wakandifwida,
Ula konzya kundi sanzya, Ime nditambule Mwami.
Ndilayanda busyu bwako, Kondilanga Mwami wangu;
englishVerses: Jesus, my Lord, to thee I cry;
Unless thou help me I must die;
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.
Helpless I am, and full of guilt,
But yet thy blood for me was spilt;
And thou canst make what thou wilt,
But take me as I am.
No preparation can I make,
My best resolves I only break;
Yet save me for thine own name’s sake,
And take me as I am.
I bow before thy mercy seat,
Behold me, Saviour, at thy feet;
Thy work begin, thy work complete,
And take me as I am.
If thou hast work for me to do,
Inspire my will, my heart renew;
And work both in, and by me, too,
And take me as I am.
And when at last the work is done,
The battle fought, the vict’ry won;
Still, still my cry shall be alone,
Lord, take me as I am.
englishChorus: Take me as I am, Take me as I am,
Oh, bring thy free salvation nigh,
And take me as I am.

title: Ciindi Ca Ku Boola Kwa Mwami
englishTune: Ciindi Ca Ku Boola Kwa Mwami
verses: Ciindi ca ku boola kwa Mwami, Ndateelela bantu bonse,
Nyenyezi zya leka kubala, Nkokuti busiku bwamana.
Kumweka kwa zuba a mwezi, mujulu, munyika lwizi
Zyompola ku bantu bonse, Kubola kwa Mwami kwaswena.
Cindi ca nkumu ilindila, Kusowa kulisumpula;
Zyangwe nkanya malamb Ôamweka, Kulanga masiku amana.
Fwambana imunzila zyonse, A amunzila zipati;
Mwite izilema a bofu, Bali ndile kuzwa kwa zuba.
chorus: Nkokuti busiku bwamana, Nkokuti busiku bwamana;
Masiku amana izuba lilazwa, nkokuti busiku bwamana.

title: Lomba Bbuku Lisololela
verses: Kuti wayanda kumvwa kasimpe, Lomba Bbuku elyo litelele.
Utamvwi ibayanda kulesya, Utateeleli benzyi bambi;
Kolomba Bbuku lil Ôakasimpe, Waliteelela uya kusika.
Zyuulu zyeenda nzila ya kufwa, Basyonto ibeenda iluleme;
Imwi nimbotu, imwi mudima, Imwi ililuleme, imwi pee.
chorus: Lomba Bbuku lisololela benzu, Kolibala mumusinzo wako;
Lomba Bbuku kolibala bunene, Bala mazuba onse.

title: Coolwe Ku Balila
verses: Jesu naya kwiita bakwe, Bala kubusigwa.

title: Muya Usalala Ndikwele
verses: Bonse basyoma muli guwe, Uya kubatola kwakwe
(Tuya kumubona Mwami Jesu) Tuya kumu bona

title: Boola Lufutuko
verses: Hena Wamumvwa Jesu Kalila A Ciingano,
Hena Wamumvwa Jesu Kalila A Ciingano,

title: Zioni Libotu
verses: Zioni Lili Kujulu, Munzi Mupya Ngwendiyanda,
Misamu mibotu Oko, Ila Micelo Minono,
Kulasalala Ngwa Oko, A buzuba Butamani
A Masi Mabotu Manji, Amazila A Golide.
A Misyini Mibotu ko Balamansene Mabotu,
Bala Masani Mabotu, Boonse Babotu Baya Ko.
Cuuno Cabwami Ca Leza, A zyuno Zili Ambali,
Kulyookezya Kubotu Ko, Munzi Mubotu Wa Mwami.

title: Tabakwe Kulila
verses: Tabakwe Kufwa ko, Boonse Iba koma,

title: Buzuba Bwaku Komana
verses: Eci Cisyomyo Cibotu, Ndaboola Mbambile Boonse
Fwambana Kuboola Mwami, Leta Ku komana.
Bafwide Bala Kubuka, Toonse Tula Kuya kwakwe,
Satani ula Kwangwa Muno kwa Ciindi Cilamfu.
Munzi Uya Kuseluka, Babi Baya ku Busyigwa,
chorus: Buzuba Bwa kuseka, Buzuba Bwa Kuseka
englishVerses: O, happy day! That fixed choice,
On thee, my Saviour and my God;
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad
‘Tis done, the great transaction’s done;
I am my Lord’s and he is mine
He drew me and I followed on,
Rejoiced to own the call divine.
Now rest, my long divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful center rest;
Nor ever from thy Lord depart,
With him ev’ry good possessed
englishChorus: Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to and pray,
And live Rejoicing ev’ry day,
Happy day! Happy day!
When Jesus washed my sins away!

title: Ndila Mucitila Nzi Jesu?
verses: Ndila Mucitila Nzi Jesu, Ndila Kumuyanda Buti,
Nendiya kutola Bbaibbele, Ndila Kuyiya Kabotu,
Nendiya Kubagwasya Bamwi, Kumuyanda Jesu Wangu.
chorus: Nceci Cindi Cakumucitila, Jesu Mufutuli Wangu,
Ndila Kukanana Luse Lwakwe, Ndila Kucilila Jesu.

title: Inguzu Zya Kutelela
verses: Twa lomba kusanzyigwa, Mu kwenda kwesu, konse,
Sanina myoyo yesu, I nywisye menda eni,
Mu kubi kwa munyika, A tu tube mu myoyo.

title: Ibbwe Lilamfu Lindinda
verses: Cimwi cindi Ônga kwasiya, nzila yaba Ômabbwe manji,
Mukwenda kwa kufutuka, cimvule ce bbwe ncilamfu.
Andikale munsi lya bbwe, mucoolwe amukupenga,
chorus: Andiulukile kwi Bbwe, Kwi Bbwe lilamfu lindinda,

title: Hena Mulatucinga?
verses: Mucizyi ula tucinga, Mucizyi ula tucinga,
Mucizyi ula tucinga, Mu Kenani lini.
Inzya tula kucingana, Inzya tula kucingana,
Inzya tula kucingana, Mu kenani Lini.

title: Lityani Ibbaibbele?
verses: Lityani Bbaibbela libotu, Mbwendiya kubuzya ime,
Kwisya kwabantu kula tusowa, Ibbuku lyakwe lityani.
Mbasyonto ba iya milawo, mbasyonto iba ibamba,
Pesi bamwi basola kwibamba, Akusandula iwane.
Mula kutyani Jesu abola, Inywe no mu isandula,
Mula kuingula twailomya, Jesu wati tamwizyi.
chorus: Banji ta baliteeleli, Lityani hena libalisye,
Lomya milawo ili kkumi, Langa kuboola kwa Jesu,

title: Munzi Wa Golinde
verses: Ku mwana a Mbelele waka fwa,
Baya kuba ma Bbwe akwe amwekesya;

title: Hena Ndilembedwe?
verses: Hena  hena ndilembedwe? Hena  hena ndilembedwe?
Jesu, Jesu ncatasiki, Jesu Jesu ncatasiki,
Baya baya kubetekwa, Baya baya kubetekwa

title: Jesu Ne Nzila
verses: Iya kuli Taata, Iya kuli Taata,
Jesu ne nzila iya kuli Taata;
Koboola tweende ku nganda ya Taata;
Kunganda ya Taata, kunganda ya Taata;
Munganda ya Taata, Munganda ya Taata;

title: Ciindi Ca Ku Paila
verses: Limwi Leza ndikasike, Kunyina ciindi cibotu;

title: Bali Ifuka Teebaka Lumba
writer: Nine Did Not Thank The Lord
englishTune: Nine Did Not Thank The Lord
verses: Omwe  buyo wakalumba Leza, Bamwi bakaya kuli?
Baluba iwaka bafwida, Inzubo zyonse nene.
Utabi mbuli bali fuka, Mube mbuli mubombe;
Ula kupailila sunu, Ula ubya mukuli.

title: Ndayanda Kuzwa Kasyoonto
writer: I Want To Come Out A Little
englishTune: I Want To Come Out A Little
verses: Ndayanda kuzwa kasyoonto mu milimo yoonse;
Limwi ciindi neli bbila muku pailisya.
Kulomba cisyomyo cakwe, Kumvwa Mwami pele.
Aku mupa kubi kwangu, Mwami ngweyanda.

title: Afwaafwi Kuli Iwe
verses: Afwaafwi kuli Ôwe lyoonse, Mweenzuma mwini mwini;
Ndila kuyanda bunene, Kwiinda lubono loonse.
Nga ula kufutusya kunkamu ya Satani,
Uya kutupa luse lyonse, Tula Ôcolwe awebo.
Twayanda kuvuna kwako, Tube mbuli ndiwe;
chorus: Ndila kuyanda kuli Ôwe, Kala andiswe lyonse.

title: Munzi Okuya
verses: Okuya, Okuya, Okuya, Amuyeye munzi okuya.
Mufutuli uli okuya Bakwesu baya kukala ko;
Okuya, Okuya, Okuya, Mufutuli uli okuya.
Ndiya kusika okuya, Musinzo uyeya kumana;
Konditola kumunzi kuya, Bangele bala kundilonda,

title: Bweza Musa
verses: No wabona kubi kunji, Musa bweza;
Ko bwezesya uta leki Musa bweza.
chorus: O bweza ula ligwasya, Musa bweza.

title: Kulaya Kwa Mubelesyi
verses: Baita É bala ita Andiye É Nkuko lino.
Ku munda É uli kule, Bakwesu É Mundi leke.
Tata ba É ma mwana Ôngu, Musyale É nyonse nene;
Kwitala É Ôlyo kuya, Ndi jisi É Mulimo ko.
chorus: Andiye É nditakali pe, Ngu Mwami.. Odita,
Andiye É a ndivuwe, Syaala nyika ya kwesu.

title: Tuya Kuseka Cifumofumo
writer: We Will Smile In The Morning
englishTune: We Will Smile In The Morning
verses: Mweenzu obombede buka, Tuya kuseka cifumo;
Leza wamba mwijwi lyakwe, Tuya kuseka cifumo.
Mutayowi bana Jesu, Tuya kuseka cifumo;
Mulange mujulu inywe, Tuya kuseka cifumo;
Misozi iya kusindwa, Tuya kuseka cifumo,
Kupenga kuya kumana, Tuya kuseka cifumo.
chorus: Kuseka kuya kuboola, Kuseka kuya ku boola,
Antela tuya kulila masiku, Tuya kuseka cifumo.

title: Kalivali
verses: Boola kobola moyo wangu ku Kalivali;
Kolanga musyini wa mamvwa, Kupenga, kupenga,
Kolanga musyini wa mamvwa, wamamvwa, wamamvwa.
Mvwa kwiita ÔLeza wangu wa ndisiila nzi?Õ
chorus: Hena ndiya kukuluba buti Mwami wangu?

title: Kunsi Kwa Mababa Akwe
verses: Mubaba lya Leza ndilakala, Antela kuli luwo lukali;
Ndiya kumusyomo ulandijata, Wandinununa ndili mwanakwe.
Mumababa Ôkwe nokuba kupenga, Ndayeya lyonse kulyokezyako;
Nyika taijisi cakundifutusya, Oko nkundajana kuumuna.
Mumababa ndila komana, Nkondiya kuyubila kupenga;
Oko kunyika taijisi cakundifutusya, Oko nkundajana kuumuna.
chorus: Ndili kunsi kwa mababa, Nguni uya kundi gusya?

title: Taakwe Kufwa Majwi Mabotu
verses: Taakwe kufwa majwi mabotu, Alazwa mumoyo ulomenye,
Oyeya luyando lwakwe Leza, Inzya mu masi onse nkwabele;
Majwi aluyando tafwi pe, tafwi pe, Majwi aluyando tafwi pe.
Kuyeya kubotu takufwi pe, Mbubona maluba mabotu;
Kula komanisya bantu bonse nene, Obali pengede konse konse,
Kuyeya kubotu takufwi, takufwi, kuyeya kubotu takufwi pe.
Luyando talufwi na tafwile, Na tuli mucuumbwe cisiya mbi;
Twa bola iswe bula boola buzuba, No tuya kuunka kuli Jesu;
Luyando lubotu talufwi, talufwi, Luyando lubotu talufwi pe.

title: Tula Cita Buti?
verses: Ngaaya makani aku sininzya, Na ila mana insi eyi;
Makani ala tuyoosya toonse, Tula cita buti?
Amu teelele nobasizibi, Mulilo ubambidwe babi;
Ku julu nkwa baluleme, Tula cita buti?
Na ilamana insi eyi, Na kuti sunu
Jesu aboole, Nakuti waita bakwe Tulacita buti?
chorus: Tula cita buti? Tula cita buti?
Na ila mana insi eyi, Tula cita buti?

title: Imbisya Lwiimbo Lwa Lumamba
verses: A mu syome ijwi lya Mwami.
englishVerses: Sound the battle cry, See! The foe is nigh;
Raise the standard high for the Lord;
Gird your armor on, Stand firm every one,Rest your cause upon His holy word.
Strong to meet the foe, Marching on we go,
While our cause we know  must prevail;
Shield and banner bright, Gleaming in the light,
Battling for the right, we ne’er can fail.
O Thou God of all Hear us while we call,
Help us one and all, by Thy grace;
When the battle’s done, And the victory won,
May we wear the crown before Thy face.
englishChorus: Rouse, then, soldiers! Rally round the banner!
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud Hosanna!
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

title: Ndali Salila
verses: Bamwi bakaka kumu sebenzela, Jesu wangu (2)
Ndasiya zya nyika, Nkamusebenzele, Jesu wangu (2)
chorus: Kwenda a Jesu mubumi bwangu bonse,
